title: What's New: Cross Environment Intercompany Posting and Approval for IC General Journals (2023)

chapters.title: Currency, Customer, Vendor and Bank Account Configuration

features.name: Cross environment intercompany posting
features.description: Intercompany partners can now reside in different environments, whether in one tenant or across tenants. Transactions between companies are handled seamlessly through the system without manual file downloads.
caveats: Requires Microsoft Entra application registration setup
Admin permissions required by default to create new intercompany partners
Both companies need currencies enabled locally if using different currencies
Companies may be in different regions

features.name: Intercompany partner setup wizard
features.description: New action that provides a wizard to establish intercompany partner connections across environments. Includes automated company information sharing and test connection verification.
caveats: Setup needed on both partner companies in parallel
Requires acceptance of data transfer and privacy conditions

features.name: Microsoft Entra authentication for cross environment intercompany
features.description: Cross environment intercompany communications require creating a Microsoft Entra app registration with client ID and specific permission sets to enable secure communication between companies.
caveats: Requires Microsoft Entra app registration outside of Business Central
Does not require developer knowledge - just Azure portal record and clicks
One registration app can be used for all environments within one tenant
Separate registration apps needed for different tenants

features.name: Permission set for cross environment intercompany
features.description: New permission set 'Cross environment API cross environment intercompany' required to send and receive communications across environments and allow other companies to authenticate.
caveats: Only admins have this permission by default
Can be assigned to other users through permission sets
Related permission set: 'Create and modified interc company Partners' controls ability to insert new partners

features.name: Intercompany setup with chart of accounts mapping
features.description: Ability to import a common chart of accounts and set up side-by-side mapping for incoming and outgoing transactions to handle different child accounts across companies.

features.name: Intercompany dimensions mapping
features.description: Side-by-side mapping of dimensions to manage different dimension setups across companies for intercompany transactions.

features.name: Intercompany multicurrency support
features.description: Intercompany partners can use different currencies; the system supports flexible currency setups across partner companies.
caveats: Both companies need the same currencies enabled locally to communicate if using different currencies

features.name: Intercompany bank-to-bank transactions
features.description: Ability to set up and perform bank account transactions in general journals between intercompany partners.

features.name: Intercompany partner customer and vendor matching
features.description: Intercompany partners can be matched with customer and vendor records to use existing customer and vendor capabilities in the product.

features.name: Intercompany journal comments
features.description: Comments are now supported in both journal transactions and document transactions for intercompany postings.

features.name: Intercompany transaction rejection after acceptance
features.description: Even after accepting an intercompany transaction, users can still reject the related document.
